build_nltk_tokenizer: build a python module that uses NLTKTokenizer to tokenize text into word-level tokens
encode_with_nltk_tokenizer: encode a string into space-separated tokens using NLTKTokenizer encode method
decode_with_nltk_tokenizer: decode a tokenized string back to text using NLTKTokenizer decode method
register_nltk_tokenizer: register the NLTK tokenizer with fairseq using the register_tokenizer decorator
test_nltk_tokenizer_encode: test the NLTKTokenizer encode method by tokenizing a sample sentence
